structure.title: Hall Structure
structure.text: The Hall Structure is the outermost realm and the starting ground of the network, where fundamental possibilities and relations take shape.

continuity.title: Continuity of the World
continuity.text: Continuity of the World is the continuous flow connecting structure to persistence, transformation, and the emergence of experience.

experience.title: Realm of Experience
experience.text: The Realm of Experience is where continuity becomes lived experience, perception, meaning, and orientation.

reference.title: Imitative Authority
reference.text: Imitative Authority is the realm where experience turns toward models, sources of authority, and choices about what should be followed.

share.title: Economy of Shares
share.text: The Economy of Shares is the realm closest to the center, where competition, distribution, shares, and positions within the network become visible.

core.title: Actuality Focus
core.text: The white center is the final point of convergence; a focus present from the beginning, whose calculation and recognition become possible only when the configuration is complete.

pages.observation: The Land of Observation; One River, One Flow

forgers.title: The Forgers of Imitation
forgers.subtitle: Ten Chapters
forgers.moral: One who displays a skill goes only as far as there are spectators; one who practices a skill goes as far as they can themselves. And a forest in which everyone is a spectator ultimately has nothing left to see but the act of watching itself.
